meta.pos: verb; verb; noun; noun; noun; noun

defs.def: to make sth increase, or become better or more successful 使增长；使兴旺

ex.s: They boosted the sales of cars.
ex.t: 他们促进了汽车的销量。

ex.s: ·Community Booster: Guiding you to develop innovative solutions for real-world challenges and create transformative progress to benefit all communities
ex.t: 社区助推器：引导你为现实世界的挑战开发创新解决方案，创造变革性进步以造福所有社区。

ex.s: You’ll compete with fewer tourists, save money, experience a different side of a popular place, and boost the economy when tourism is traditionally slower.
ex.t: 你会与更少的游客竞争、省钱、体验热门地点的不同一面，并在传统淡季提振当地经济。

ex.s: The work really gives me a boost.
ex.t: 这工作真的让我精神振奋。

ex.s: Therefore, they can work for longer, consume more and in general be boost to the economy.
ex.t: 因此，他们可以工作更长时间，消费更多，总的来说对经济起到推动作用。

ex.s: Instead, farmers needed to boost yields in the fields they had.
ex.t: 相反，农民需要在他们已有的田地里提高产量。

ex.s: In fact, don’t wait until you’ve made a mistake to try this — it’s a great way to boost self-confidence at any time.
ex.t: 事实上，不要等到犯了错才去尝试这个方法——它随时都是增强自信的好方式。

defs.def: something that helps or encourages sb/sth 帮助；激励

ex.s: The sharing economy has great economy-boosting potential, and operates with the understanding that there exists a mutual trust between those involved.
ex.t: 共享经济具有很强的提振经济潜力，其运行基于这样一种共识：参与者之间存在相互信任。

defs.def: an increase in sth 增长；提高

ex.s: Compared to traditional garden plots, they increase carbon absorption, reduce stormwater runoff and boost habitat and biodiversity significantly.
ex.t: 与传统的小块园地相比，它们增加了碳吸收，减少了雨水径流，并显著提升了栖息地和生物多样性。
每一个“赞”都增强了我的信心。

ex.s: It plays a part in the image we present to the world, and making an effort with your appearance can leave a positive first impression on others and boost your confidence.
ex.t: 它在我们展示给世界的形象中起着作用，而打理外表能给他人留下良好的第一印象，并增强你的自信。

defs.def: an increase in power in an engine or a piece of electrical equipment （发动机或电气设备的）功率增大

ex.s: In humans, a greatly enlarged brain boosts self-control, just as it boosts problem-solving skills in the social as well as the physical world.
ex.t: 在人类身上，显著增大的大脑增强了自控力，正如它也增强了我们在社会和物质世界中解决问题的能力。

ex.s: Sign up for our space programme now and give your knowledge of aviation and space a boost!
ex.t: 现在就报名我们的太空项目，为你的航空与航天知识加把劲！

defs.def: an act of pushing sb up from behind （从后面的）向上一推，一举
